At PetFect, we value your privacy and work to protect your personal information in a transparent and secure way. This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect, how we use it and what your rights are.

• Name and email address.
• Optional information such as phone number.
• Data related to pets.
• Technical device information.
• App usage and error data.
We use your data to create and manage your account, provide the app’s features, store pet information, improve the service and detect technical issues.
PetFect uses external services such as Firebase and Supabase to store and process information. These providers apply appropriate security measures to protect your data.
You can access, modify or request the deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting our support email.
We apply reasonable security measures to protect your information. However, no system can guarantee absolute security.
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Important changes will be communicated within the app.
Last updated: May 2026 · Effective from registration

By downloading, installing or using the PetFect application, available on iOS and Android, as well as its web platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions, together with our Privacy Policy and any additional rules published in the app.\n\nIf you do not agree with any of these terms, please do not use PetFect. Continued use of the application after changes have been published implies acceptance of those changes.
⚠️ These terms constitute a legally binding agreement between you and PetFect S.L., located in Pozuelo de Alarcón, Madrid, Spain.

PetFect is intended for anyone over the age of 14. Users under 18 must have the express consent of a parent or legal guardian to register and use paid services.

Institutions such as shelters, animal protection organizations and veterinary clinics must prove their activity during the institutional verification process before accessing the Professional Plan.

Recognized user types:

 • Adopters: people looking to adopt or put pets up for adoption.
 • Owners: owners of lost or found pets.
 • Institutions: shelters, animal protection organizations, veterinary clinics and associations.
 • General community: animal lovers interested in animal welfare.

To access all PetFect features, you must create an account. By registering, you agree to:

 • Provide truthful, accurate and up-to-date information.
 • Keep your password confidential.
 • Not share your account with third parties.
 • Notify us immediately of any unauthorized access.

You can register with email or through Google Sign-In. Each person may only have one active personal account.
🔒 PetFect will never ask for your password by email, SMS or internal messaging. If you receive such a request, report it to support.

PetFect is a platform focused on animal welfare. All use of the app must respect this purpose and the laws in force in Spain and the European Union.

It is prohibited to:

 • Publish false information about adoptions or lost pets.
 • Use the app for the commercial buying and selling of animals.
 • Publish content that encourages animal abuse, abandonment or illegal animal trading.
 • Impersonate another person or institution.
 • Send unsolicited communications, spam, to other users.
 • Attempt to access systems, accounts or third-party data without authorization.
 • Use bots, scrapers or automated tools to interact with the platform.
🚫 Failure to comply with these rules may result in temporary or permanent account suspension, without the right to a refund for contracted premium services.

PetFect acts as an intermediary between users. We are not responsible for the accuracy of posts or for the outcome of adoption or search processes, although we apply mixed verification mechanisms, automatic and human review.

By posting, the user agrees that:

 • The published pet exists and the information is real and up to date.
 • The same animal will not be published in multiple active posts at the same time.
 • The post will be updated or deleted when the pet has been found or adopted.
 • No money will be requested or accepted in exchange for pet adoption, as this is prohibited by law in Spain.

PetFect reserves the right to remove posts that violate these rules without prior notice.
📍 Geolocated alerts are shared with other users within a configurable radius. By enabling them, you accept that your approximate location may be visible to other app users at that time.

The processing of your personal data is governed by the General Data Protection Regulation, GDPR, EU 2016/679, and Spanish Organic Law 3/2018 on Personal Data Protection and guarantee of digital rights, LOPDGDD.

Data we collect and its purpose:

 • Name and email → Account management and communication.
 • Geolocation → Generation of nearby pet alerts.
 • Device and operating system → Technical improvement of the app.
 • Notification token → Sending push notifications.
 • Payment data → Processed by Google Play / App Store. PetFect does not store it.

PetFect does not sell or transfer your data to third parties for advertising purposes without your consent. You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, deletion and portability by writing to:

privacidad@petfect.app

PetFect offers optional paid services. Prices are in euros and include applicable VAT.

Available plans:

 • Free version → Free, with ads.
 • Individual Premium → €5.99 / month.
 • Featured post or urgent alert → €2.99, one-time payment.
 • Professional plan, shelters and veterinary clinics → from €29.99 / month.

Cancellation and refund policy:

Monthly subscriptions can be cancelled at any time. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. No prorated refunds are made except in cases provided by EU consumer regulations, 14 days from the first purchase if the service has not been used.

Payments are managed by Google Play or App Store. PetFect does not store bank or card details.

All PetFect elements — name, logo, design, source code, texts and interface — are the property of PetFect S.L. or its licensors and are protected by Spanish and European intellectual property law.\n\nBy publishing content on PetFect, such as photos or descriptions, you retain ownership of your rights, but grant us a non-exclusive, free and worldwide license to display, distribute and adapt that content within the platform and in our marketing communications, solely for the purpose of operating and promoting the service.
📷 Only publish photos and content that you own or have permission to use. Do not publish images of third parties without their consent.

PetFect acts as an intermediary platform. We do not guarantee the outcome of any adoption, search or reunion process, nor the accuracy of information published by users.

To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, PetFect shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, special or consequential damages arising from the use or inability to use the service.

PetFect’s total accumulated liability to a user shall not exceed the amount paid by that user in the 12 months prior to the event giving rise to the claim.

PetFect implements technical and organizational security measures in accordance with the GDPR, but no system is 100% infallible. We will notify any security breach affecting your data within the legal period of 72 hours.

PetFect may modify these Terms at any time. We will notify you of significant changes by push notification or email at least 15 days in advance. Continued use of the service after that period implies acceptance of the new terms.

We may suspend or cancel your account if you breach these terms, if we detect fraudulent activity, or if required by applicable law.

Law and jurisdiction:

These Terms are governed by Spanish law. For any dispute, both parties submit to the courts and tribunals of Madrid, unless applicable consumer regulations establish another jurisdiction.
